newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev inches up to 493-497 vs dlr at close.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev inches up to 493-497 vs dlr at close.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 493-497 per dollar, a touch firmer than 493-500 in the morning as foreign currency supply topped demand in thin pre-Christmas interbank trade, dealers said.
"Dollar demand was light due to low lev liquidity and a general market lull as most banks have already closed forex positions ahead of Christmas holidays," a commercial bank dealer said.
Foreign currency supply outweighed demand in thin volume and was partly absorbed by the central bank, which was seen buying dollars at 495-496 levs, traders said.
Central bank officials were not available for comment.
Markets will be closed in Bulgaria from Monday through Thursday for Christmas. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-876032
